title: Blood glucose test
what: This test shows how much sugar is in your blood right now. Blood is taken from a vein or a finger.
why: To check for diabetes, if you are very thirsty, pee often, or feel weak, at a checkup, and to monitor treatment.
duration: the blood draw takes 2 to 5 minutes. Results usually come the same day or the next
tell_doctor: If you have diabetes and take tablets or insulin. Tell your doctor, who will decide what to do that morning
If you were ill recently or take hormones

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Strictly fasting: usually 8 to 14 hours without food. Plain water is fine.

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: Have a normal dinner, without overeating or alcohol. Do not change your diet in the days before the test.

prepare.title: In the morning
prepare.text: Do not smoke, chew gum, or drink sweet drinks, tea, or coffee.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop them on your own. If you have diabetes, ask your doctor how to take your medicines on the test day.

bring: Some food, to eat right after the test, especially if you have diabetes
steps: You sit down and rest your arm on the table
The skin is cleaned with antiseptic
A quick prick in a vein or a finger
A cotton pad is pressed on the spot
after: You can eat right after the test
Your doctor reviews the result. If in doubt, the test is repeated or other tests are ordered
red_flags: If you have diabetes: if you feel shaky, have a cold sweat, or feel confused while fasting, eat some sugar and tell the nurse

faq.q: Can I brush my teeth before a blood sugar test?
faq.a: Usually it is better without toothpaste, or with sugar-free toothpaste. It is a small thing, but some labs ask for it.

faq.q: Is finger blood the same as vein blood?
faq.a: Almost, but the numbers differ a little. To make a diagnosis, doctors more often use blood from a vein.

reminders.text: Blood sugar test tomorrow. Do not eat after dinner. Water is fine.
Blood sugar test soon. Do not eat or have sweet drinks. Bring some food for afterward.
